name: compound request splits into the right sub-request tree (WP-2.4)

turns.user: check my disk usage and list my running services
turns.description: A genuine two-part compound. The decomposer must split it into the sub-request TREE (a disk-usage sub-request AND a running-services sub-request), not answer one part or route the whole thing to a single handler. This asserts the decomposition STRUCTURE (the sub-request set), closing the gap where a compound was graded on only its final answer. Protective: a regression that stops the decomposer splitting this class breaks it.
assertions: a genuine multi-part request routes to the compound decompose path

assertions.description: the decomposition tree covers both a disk sub-request and a services sub-request
exactly two sub-requests — not under- or over-split
